scenarios.title: Customer: guest to first order
scenarios.description: Guest browse → sheet → pay → location → tracking

scenarios.title: Shop onboarding v2
scenarios.description: Identity → referral → GST/PAN → fee → type → licences → address/pin → SLA → live

scenarios.title: My team
scenarios.description: Dealer builds and changes his team

cases.title: Guest: /shops → shop page → Add to cart → /cart → Place order opens the login sheet over the cart
cases.expected: No sign-in page anywhere before checkout; sheet step 1 of 3 on /cart; cart kept

cases.title: Guest: v2 account APIs refuse a caller without a session
cases.expected: 401/403 for status, mobile, delivery-location, team, invitations, franchise start, v2 fee

cases.title: Guest: /franchise/start, /dealer/team, /team/invitations send a guest to sign in
cases.expected: Redirect to /signin

cases.title: Guest opens a customer's /r/<code> link
cases.expected: 307 to / (not /signin)

cases.title: Login sheet step 1: Terms tick required; e-mail step shows acceptance time (IST) and Google / e-mail link
cases.expected: Continue disabled until ticked; 'Terms accepted <date>, hh.mm AM/PM IST'; still on /cart

cases.title: Login sheet step 1 shows the Terms version with the IST time
cases.expected: Version and time of the accepted Terms shown

cases.title: Login sheet for a new e-mail: link / code, back to cart, mobile code, account + wallet
cases.expected: Account created, e-mail verified, mobile verified, wallet; back on /cart

cases.title: Login sheet step 3: mobile SMS code (mock) verifies the number; account DONE with wallet
cases.expected: Wrong code refused; right code → DONE, mobile verified, wallet

cases.title: Returning customer: no sheet; no payment preselected; address after paying → delivery-location prompt → order tracking
cases.expected: Button 'Choose how to pay' disabled until a method is chosen; prompt after placing; saved address sets it; order page opens

cases.title: Checkout API without a payment method
cases.expected: 422 'Choose how to pay: online or cash on delivery.'

cases.title: Address pending: shop packs and marks ready; rider dispatch waits for the location
cases.expected: Shop can mark READY; no rider assigned (409 'waiting for the customer's delivery location') until the address is set

cases.title: Address pending: customer cancels (also after the shop accepted) with a full refund
cases.expected: Cancel 200; wallet back to the balance before the order

cases.title: Pickup order needs no delivery address
cases.expected: Order placed without address; never address-pending

cases.title: Cash on delivery with the address after payment
cases.expected: COD order accepted without an address, address pending

cases.title: Shop identity step: Terms tick with version, links open the Terms and Privacy pages, e-mail, mobile SMS code
cases.expected: Version shown; both links open the documents; mobile code verifies

cases.title: Fee step amounts Shop / Wholesale
v2 steps refuse to run out of order
cases.expected: Fee, licences, agreement before GST/PAN → 409 STEP_OPEN

cases.title: Identity step done once; returning owner skips it
cases.expected: Terms version recorded; screen not shown again

cases.title: Admin → Shop documents → Registration licences queue
cases.expected: Queue with waiting / promised / verified / rejected opens; API lists entries

cases.title: Referral step: Request a referral code
cases.expected: Request form opens (name, mobile, shop type, address)

cases.title: GST/PAN → fee via sandbox (leave unpaid → resume) → type → licences (4 options, MUST_HAVE no Later) → address + pin → SLA → live / review
cases.expected: Shop live or with operator review; fee paid once

cases.title: Dealer opens My team: search, team list, history in IST
cases.expected: Page loads; IST times

cases.title: Search by exact mobile and e-mail (masked name); unknown → not found
cases.expected: Masked name only; not found for unknown

cases.title: Request as team lead; decline; second request accepted → TEAM_LEAD with code
cases.expected: No role until accept; decline leaves none; accept → GKT code

cases.title: Team lead adds an agent under himself; agent accepts
cases.expected: AGENT reporting to the lead

cases.title: Invite link for an unregistered contact; share; guest asked to sign in; withdraw
cases.expected: /team/join/<token>, 7 days, WhatsApp/SMS/e-mail share

cases.title: Downgrade blocked while agents report to the lead; reassign → downgrade; upgrade agent
cases.expected: 409 with agents; then OK

cases.title: Admin user page: marketplace roles, history (IST), override REMOVE
cases.expected: OVERRIDE row; applies at once

cases.title: Dealer removes a member's role; history with IST
cases.expected: Customer only; every change listed

cases.title: No live shop → /shop/register?return=/franchise/start
cases.expected: Redirect with return path

cases.title: /franchise/start: models, ≤2 per zone, LAUNCH_1Y, no 30-day KYC
cases.expected: Shown as stated

cases.title: Free dealer: live at once with GKD code
cases.expected: GKD code, dealer APPROVED

cases.title: Paid franchise: zone, LAUNCH_1Y, coupon, sandbox payment → GKF code
cases.expected: Live on payment with GKF code

cases.title: Admin → Franchise → Plans
cases.expected: LAUNCH_1Y listed; Add plan
